title: Two infinite families of base-6 Lychrel numbers
description: Unconditional Lean 4 formalization of two explicit, strictly increasing, pairwise disjoint infinite families x(m) and y(m) (m >= 0) of base-6 Lychrel numbers under repeated base-6 reverse-and-add T(n) = n + rev_6(n).
